description: Execute an Agent Studio agent. Send a message and get a response. Use executionId to maintain conversation sessions.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

executionId.description: Previous execution ID to continue a conversation session. Omit for new sessions.

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

message.description: User message to send to the agent

name: crm_execute_agent
